name: sshi_fbr_zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed on S2 and S4 (insufficient voltage/power) and S3 (overvoltage). To fix S2 and S4, I am adding a Parallel Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit. An inductor and a switch in parallel with the piezo terminals, triggered at voltage extrema, will flip the charge on the piezo capacitance, significantly increasing the harvested energy and the average output voltage. To fix the S3 overvoltage issue, I am adding a DZ33 Zener diode as a clamp on the output node to ensure v_max does not exceed 3.6 V.
